previous: Admin area #77: six separate table pages (tests, AI reviews, parents, children, cards and waitlist, emails). No page shows each family's stage, no KPIs, no charts. Payment exists only in Stripe.
decision: What should the admin home look like so Savar sees, every day, where each family is (signed up, started, finished, payment page, card saved, paying) and what was emailed?
primary_axis: information hierarchy of the admin home: numbers first, families first, or events first
route: /admin?variant=0|A|B|C (0 is the current tests list). Local dev: add &demo=1 for 72 made-up families. Real data needs an admin sign-in.
invariants: same data for every variant: parents, children, tests, reports, card setups, waitlist, email log, Stripe subscriptions (read only)
one stage per family, the furthest it got: Signed up, Started test, Finished test, Payment page, Card saved, Paying, Waitlist
Paying = a Stripe subscription that is active, trialing or past due on a saved card's customer
emails counted: start, continue and come back reminders, report email, report alert to Savar, unsubscribes; sign-in codes and links are not logged by the site
ranges Today, 7 days, 30 days, All time, Pacific days; deltas against the period before
clicking a family opens one drawer with its journey, tests, payment and every email

options.name: Daily dashboard
options.bet: KPI tiles with sparklines and deltas, funnel beside a day-by-day chart, a 'Needs you' list, the families table with a Stage column and stage pills, and an email report (subject, trigger, sent in range, sent all, failed, last sent)
options.benefit: Answers 'how are we doing' and 'who is where' on one page
options.cost: Long page; the table is below the fold
options.risk: Many numbers to read when data is small

options.name: Pipeline board
options.bet: One column per stage with family cards (time in stage, last email, unsubscribed); numbers in one dark strip; an email heat map by day
options.benefit: Who is stuck where is visible at a glance; oldest first
options.cost: Weak for trends; columns get long
options.risk: Needs horizontal scroll on small screens

options.name: Activity inbox
options.bet: Left rail of views with counts (activity, needs you, each stage, each email kind, failed), a day-grouped event log in the middle, today vs yesterday and a 14-day chart on the right
options.benefit: Shows what happened and every email in order; good for a daily check
options.risk: The log gets long when volume grows

recommendation: A as the admin home, with the family drawer. Take C's day-grouped activity log as a tab or section, and B's 'time in stage' on each row.
verdict: Savar, 2026-10-12: A as the daily dashboard (the admin home), and C built too, as a separate Activity tab for the daily activity. B not chosen. Built in branch site/admin-dashboard (D-099).
